source.title: Document the greeting output
source.body: Add a greeting example to docs/guide.md showing the existing greet(name) result for Ada as Hello, Ada. Keep src/greeting.py and the public API unchanged. Acceptance: the guide contains that exact example and the existing greeting test passes. This is one documentation change; no configuration, deployment or prerequisite changes are needed. Do not create a workspace during this review.

repository_files.docs/guide.md:
# Greeting

The greeting function accepts a name.
repository_files.docs/requirements.md:
# Current Requirements

The greeting function returns Hello, followed by the supplied name. Documentation examples describe existing behavior.
